rag.label: Draft RAG evaluation questions
rag.origin: scripts/prepare_evals.py; separate from the datagen seed-pack generator.

fields.meaning: Evaluation case ID.
Request text derived from a historical ticket or an authored unanswerable prompt.
List of relevant KB IDs; empty for ten authored unanswerable cases. Labels are provisional.
Draft answer based on resolution notes, or an authored abstention expectation.
Historical ticket provenance; absent on manually specified unanswerable cases.
Original ticket device display label; absent on unanswerable cases and needs normalization for filtering.

development for the first 60 answerable cases; heldout for the remaining 30 answerable plus ten unanswerable cases.

rag.notes: First 90 distinct linked KB IDs encountered in historical ticket order yield 90 provisional question/answer pairs; ten authored unanswerables are appended. Distinct IDs are not a guarantee of independent template families. Current evaluator ignores split and reports on the supplied pool, so its score is not a heldout-only result.

contracts.label: MCP tool schema snapshot
contracts.notes: Schema metadata, not employee training examples. Compare snapshots in CI and review breaking changes; never auto-approve a changed snapshot.

release.label: Release identity and thresholds
release.notes: Records model/prompt/index/policy and target metrics. Unconfigured revisions and null measurements do not certify readiness.

human_labels.label: Required human calibration examples (not supplied)
human_labels.notes: Expected schema: example_id, question, sources, candidate_answer, rubric_version, human_score, annotator/review metadata. Store judge_score and judge_model/revision separately. This describes the required future artifact, not an existing file or a completed set of 30 labels.

telemetry.label: Operational observations
telemetry.origin: Emitted while running the API/tools/model; optional OTLP export and bounded in-memory samples.
telemetry.notes: Current measurement rows: operation, seconds, error. Dashboard fields: sample_count, request_p95_s, operation_error_rate, cost_per_resolved_request and cost_status. Provider tokens and trace/span IDs are operational metadata, not training labels. No durable collector dataset is bundled.
